headline: Business Development & Growth Manager | Crypto, Fintech & Web3
summary: Bilingual (Arabic/English) Business Development and Growth specialist with 8+ years of experience driving customer acquisition, market expansion, and strategic partnerships in the crypto, fintech, and financial sectors. Proven track record in managing B2B and B2C sales cycles, from institutional onboarding to retail user growth across MENA, EU, and Asian markets. Expert in identifying high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs) and institutional clients, negotiating contracts, and building robust referral and affiliate networks. Skilled in CRM management, KPI tracking, and cross-functional collaboration to align marketing, product, and sales strategies for maximum ROI and compliance.

experience.title: Growth & Business Development Manager
bullets: Directed customer acquisition and market expansion strategies for major crypto and financial platforms, managing end-to-end sales cycles for retail and institutional clients across MENA, EU, and Asia.
Identified and onboarded a diverse portfolio of clients, including High-Net-Worth Individuals (HNWIs) and corporate partners, by leveraging warm networks and targeted outreach.
Forged strategic alliances with liquidity providers, market makers, and regional blockchain projects to enhance platform depth and drive user adoption.
Managed full-funnel KPIs including ROAS, conversion rates, and pipeline health, utilizing CRM tools to track performance and optimize sales strategies.
Collaborated with marketing and product teams to design high-impact acquisition campaigns, referral programs, and affiliate networks that maximized customer lifetime value.

experience.title: Community & Marketing Manager
bullets: Built and managed a pipeline of VIP traders and HNWIs, providing white-glove onboarding and tailored account services to boost retention and engagement.
Represented the exchange at regional blockchain and fintech networking events, driving brand awareness and generating qualified leads for the sales team.
Partnered with KOLs, influencers, and web3 communities to funnel traffic to the exchange, resulting in significant user growth in the MENA region.
Ensured all business development and marketing activities adhered to local AML/KYC regulations and compliance standards.

cover_letter: With over eight years of experience driving growth in the crypto and fintech sectors, I am eager to bring my expertise in B2B sales and strategic partnerships to BitOasis. My background includes successfully onboarding institutional clients and HNWIs, managing complex sales cycles, and building robust referral networks across MENA and global markets. I am skilled in CRM management, KPI tracking, and navigating regulatory landscapes to ensure compliant and efficient business expansion. I am confident my ability to bridge technical financial products with compelling sales strategies will help BitOasis achieve its market expansion goals in the GCC region.

screening.q: Do you have 8+ years of experience in Business Development, B2B Sales, or Partnerships?
Do you have at least 1-2 years of experience in the cryptocurrency, blockchain, or fintech space?
Do you have an existing network of institutional players, family offices, or HNWI clients in Bahrain and the GCC region?
Are you proficient in CRM software such as Salesforce or HubSpot?
Are you familiar with the financial regulatory landscape in Bahrain (CBB) and the MENA region?
